title: Colour input
summary: The native colour picker beside an editable hex field that stay in step; the field accepts #abc, abc and #aabbcc and is normalised to #rrggbb.

props.name: value
props.description: The colour as #rrggbb. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising the commit event, as a native control does: pk-form raises pk-reset after it, so a host that mirrors the value reads it again there. A browser state restore also sets it silently.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Shows label as visible text above the field (linked to it), for use without a pk-field.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-colour
events.description: A valid colour was picked or typed (lowercase #rrggbb).

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label shown by showLabel.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The row of swatch and hex field.

a11y: Both inputs are labelled; text that is not a colour sets aria-invalid and a validity message; the picker is the platform's own, so it is keyboard and screen-reader accessible everywhere. The swatch is 44px on a phone.
